senses.gloss: הֵדִיחַ (b. h.; v. דְּחַהּ) [to brighten,] to wash off, cleanse, rinse.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 8b">Ḥull. 8ᵇ</cite> <cite ref="M00286"><he>מֵדִיחַ</he></cite> he must wash the meat (at the place where the knife passed); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Tamid 4:2">Tam. IV, 2</cite> <he>בית המְדִיחִין</he> the washers’ hall where the offering meat was washed.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 3:5:3">Y. Ab. Zar. III, 42ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>לָדִיחַ</he> = <he>לְהָדִיחַ</he>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Makhshirin 4:3">Makhsh. IV, 3</cite> <he>בשביל שתּוּדַח</he> in order that the dish may be washed by the rain; <cite ref="Chullin 16a">Ḥull. 16ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 11b">Sabb. 11ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:1">Koh. R. to VII, 1</cite>; Midr. Sam. ch. XXIII.
